analysis.bootstrap_interval: pointwise 95% percentile; whole runs within arm within model; no undefined draws discarded
analysis.cr_interval: 97.5% equal-tailed Clopper-Pearson per arm; opposite endpoints give at least 95% per-comparison coverage
